segments.name: Asset Management
segments.description: Provides diversified investment management and related research services globally to institutional, retail and private wealth clients.
segments.evidence: We provide diversified investment management and related services globally to a broad range of clients through our three distribution channels: Institutions, Retail and Private Wealth Management.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay the company investment advisory and services fees, generally calculated as a percentage of assets under management, plus some performance-based fees.
revenueModel.evidence: Generally, we are compensated for our investment services on the basis of investment advisory and services fees calculated as a percentage of AUM.
